IN A WORLD WHERE IT'S NORMAL FOR YOUNG BOYS AND GIRLS TO POSSESS A SPECIAL POWER KNOWN AS "IRIS"... TORU, A BOY WHO "DOESN'T HAVE ANY POWER" AND IS THEREFORE THE TARGET OF CONSTANT BULLYING, LIVED BY HIS MOTTO OF 'MINIMAL EXPOSURE' - TO LIVE WITHOUT STANDING OUT. HOWEVER, AFTER RECEIVING A CERTAIN "CONFESSION" FROM KOYUKI, A POPULAR GIRL AT SCHOOL, HIS SUPPOSEDLY PEACEFUL SCHOOL LIFE IS SHATTERED. THUS, HIS MOTTO BEGINS TO SHAKE...! THIS IS AN EXCITING SCHOOL FANTASY STORY THAT STARTS FROM THE MEETING OF A BOY AND GIRL.
蛍たかな +ピロ式 Hotarutakana + Piroshiki
IN CLASS 2-6 WITH ASAHI AND HIJIRI

HER IRIS ALLOWS HER TO SEE QUALIFIED PEOPLE. WHETHER A PERSON IS QUALIFIED OR NOT IS INDICATED BY AN O OR X ABOVE THEIR HEAD. AS FOR WHAT A PERSON IS QUALIFIED FOR, THAT IS DETERMINED BY WHAT KOYUKI IS THINKING OF AT THAT MOMENT.

IN CHAPTER 1, WHILE ELECTING A PRESIDENT, THE REASON SHE ONLY LOOKED AT STUDENTS WAS BECAUSE IN ORDER TO BE QUALIFIED TO BE THE PRESIDENT IN THAT SCHOOL, YOU HAVE TO BE ONE OF THEIR STUDENTS, SO THAT CONDITION WAS ADDED IN AUTOMATICALLY. THAT'S WHY KOYUKI WAS QUITE TROUBLED AFTER HAVING LOOKED AT ALMOST ALL THE STUDENTS.

HIS PERSONALITY IS PESSIMISTIC AND RUDE, BOTH SEEM TO HAVE BEEN BORN AS A RESULT OF BULLYING. AS ONE WOULD EXPECT, AFTER HIS EXPERIENCES FROM HIS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL YEARS, THE DEBUT OF HIS "MINIMAL EXPOSURE" POLICY WAS IN HIGH SCHOOL, HOWEVER, IN THE FIRST CHAPTER, THE NATURAL ENEMY OF THAT PEACEFUL SCHOOL LIFE APPEARS... BUT BECAUSE OF HIS ABILITY TO ANALYZE, NO MATTER HOW MUCH HE TRIES, HE CAN'T CUT HIMSELF FREE FROM THIS UNLUCKY QUALITY OR HIS UNFORTUNATE PAST (REFERENCE TO CH4).
HE'S A NEGATIVE CHARACTER WHO YOU WOULDN'T THINK WOULD BE THE PROTAGONIST OF A SHOUNEN MANGA, AND HE WANTS TO CONTINUE DOING THINGS HIS WAY.
THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR PURCHASING THIS BOOK. THIS IS MY FIRST TANKOUBON... IT WOULD MAKE ME HAPPY IF YOU FEEL EVEN THE SLIGHTEST THING AFTER READING THIS MANGA.
